en.NAME: Agent Deployment Plan
en.DESCRIPTION: Wizard template for one-click Core RM agent deployment. Create a Document of this type for each deployment plan, for example AGENT_123_DEPLOYMENT. The document stores references to host resources, secrets, users, agent resources, runtime settings, Micrometer defaults, and execution options. Secret values are never copied into the document; only entity ids are stored.

en.NAME: Core URL
en.LABEL: Core URL
en.DESCRIPTION: Base URL used by the agent for authentication and shared Core APIs, for example https://core.example.com.

en.NAME: Agent Code
en.LABEL: Agent Code
en.DESCRIPTION: Stable resource code for a new agent, for example AGENT_PROD_APP_01. Required when creating an agent resource.

en.NAME: Agent User
en.LABEL: Agent User
en.DESCRIPTION: Existing Core user account that owns/runs the deployed agent. The wizard does not create users; create the user first if it does not exist.

en.NAME: Artifact URL
en.LABEL: Artifact URL
en.DESCRIPTION: Optional URL to the agent jar or package. Leave empty when the deployment script should use the default artifact source.

en.NAME: Agent Port
en.LABEL: Agent Port
en.DESCRIPTION: Local HTTP port used by the Spring Boot agent process, for example 8081.

en.NAME: Host
en.LABEL: Host
en.DESCRIPTION: Existing Linux host resource that will run the Core RM agent. Create and configure the Linux host resource, including its access credentials, before using this deployment plan.

en.NAME: Linux Host
en.DESCRIPTION: Linux host resource configured for remote access.

en.NAME: Agent
en.LABEL: Agent
en.DESCRIPTION: Select an existing Core RM agent resource, or choose Create new to collect the fields required to create an agent resource during deployment.
en.PLACEHOLDER: Select an agent or Create new...

en.NAME: Agent
en.DESCRIPTION: Core RM agent resource.

en.NAME: Version
en.LABEL: Version
en.DESCRIPTION: Agent software version to install or verify. Use latest for the currently published artifact, or provide a concrete version such as 1.4.2.

en.NAME: Service Name
en.LABEL: Service Name
en.DESCRIPTION: System service name created or updated by the deployment script, for example core-rm-agent.

en.NAME: Micrometer Sensor Definition
en.LABEL: Micrometer Sensor Definition
en.DESCRIPTION: Sensor definition attached to the created agent resource. The default is AGENT_MICROMETER.

en.NAME: Micrometer
en.DESCRIPTION: Native Micrometer sensor definitions.

en.NAME: Micrometer Schedule
en.LABEL: Micrometer Schedule
en.DESCRIPTION: How often the deployed agent publishes Micrometer metrics. Use FIXED_DELAY with an ISO 8601 duration such as PT60S for every 60 seconds, PT5M for every 5 minutes, or PT1H for hourly polling. Use CRON with a Quartz cron expression such as 0 0/5 * * * ? for every 5 minutes at wall-clock boundaries.

en.NAME: Core RM URL
en.LABEL: Core RM URL
en.DESCRIPTION: Base URL used by the agent for Core RM configuration and sensor endpoints, for example https://core-rm.example.com.

en.NAME: Java Home
en.LABEL: Java Home
en.DESCRIPTION: Optional JAVA_HOME path on the remote host. Leave empty to use java from PATH.

en.NAME: Agent API Key
en.LABEL: Agent API Key
en.DESCRIPTION: User secret that contains the API key used by the remote agent to authenticate to Core as the selected agent user. The plan stores only the secret id; the deployment script resolves the secret value in memory.
en.PLACEHOLDER: Select an API key user secret

en.NAME: API Key
en.DESCRIPTION: UserSecret containing the Core API key used by the remote agent.

en.NAME: Executor Script
en.LABEL: Executor Script
en.DESCRIPTION: Java script that executes the reviewed deployment plan. The default is AGENT_DEPLOYMENT.

en.NAME: Agent Deployment
en.DESCRIPTION: Scripts in the Agent Deployment category.

en.NAME: Agent Name
en.LABEL: Agent Name
en.DESCRIPTION: Human-readable agent name stored in NLS, for example Production App Server Agent.

en.NAME: Dry Run
en.LABEL: Dry Run
en.DESCRIPTION: When true, the executor sends progress notifications without executing remote commands. When false, it performs the deployment.

en.NAME: Install Directory
en.LABEL: Install Directory
en.DESCRIPTION: Absolute directory on the Linux host where the agent is installed, for example /opt/core-rm-agent.

en.NAME: Host
en.DESCRIPTION: Select the existing Linux host resource that will run the agent.

en.NAME: Agent Identity
en.DESCRIPTION: Core user and API key used by the deployed agent to authenticate back to Core RM.

en.NAME: Execution
en.DESCRIPTION: Deployment script and run options used after the plan has been reviewed.

en.NAME: Monitoring
en.DESCRIPTION: Default Micrometer sensor and publication schedule created for the agent.

en.NAME: Agent
en.DESCRIPTION: Select an existing agent resource or collect the information needed to create one.

en.NAME: Endpoints
en.DESCRIPTION: Core and Core RM URLs written to the deployed agent runtime configuration.

en.NAME: Runtime
en.DESCRIPTION: Remote installation directory, service name, Java runtime, port, and artifact location.
